sourceDescription: Owner-supplied photograph of the printed Cofein pizza-menu cover, 7 September 2026. The original cover reads COFEIN / COFFEE BAR & DINER.
method: Vector contours traced from the photographed white lettering after orientation and perspective correction. Tiny print/dust pinholes removed; no substitute font, generated lettering, or stylistic redraw.
assetKind: Photographic-source outline tracing, not an original digital logo master or identified typeface.

variants.cofein-lockup.svg: COFEIN and original COFFEE BAR & DINER descriptor
variants.cofein-monogram.svg: C contour taken from that same COFEIN lettering

note: Use one of these outlines for display branding. Do not retype the restaurant name in a display font. Proportions reflect the supplied printed source; replace these assets together if the original digital master is supplied.
